purpose: Research-guided improvement after public submission 1210; no public-score optimization

sources.title: Watermark Anything with Localized Messages (ICLR 2025)
sources.finding: Local watermark presence and message recovery are spatial prediction tasks; its training couples a dedicated embedder and extractor.
sources.application: Useful design principles for dense guidance, but WAM weights are not a direct decoder for the three fixed hackathon embedders.

sources.title: Mask Image Watermarking (2025)
sources.finding: Mask-guided local extraction reduces interference from irrelevant image regions. Its encoder is also part of the proposed system.
sources.application: Motivates testing region-aware guidance with the fixed provided watermark models, without claiming the paper's scores transfer to this dataset.

sources.title: What Breaks Local Watermarks? (2026)
sources.finding: Distinguishes region localization from synchronization and documents TrustMark's optional region detector. Geometric changes and generative edits can strongly degrade recovery.
sources.application: Test the official frozen TrustMark region detector as a structural prior. Do not use benchmark labels or assume its evaluation matches the hackathon.

sources.title: Adobe TrustMark implementation
sources.finding: Official code includes optional bounding-box detection and verified Q-model weights.
sources.application: Isolated pinned source and official weights, no upgrade of the existing environment. Extract regions without hackathon labels.

bbox_trial_declared_before_results.retirement_reason: Melvyn requested a learned extension of Adobe's work, with no fixed box-to-mask blending. The box-prior experiment is retained for the research audit only; it is not a submission candidate.

competition_eligibility.evidence: The Watermark Localization statement provides TrustMark extractor/embedder wrappers, but does not explicitly address additional external pretrained checkpoints. The presentation and public leaderboard do not resolve this question.
competition_eligibility.distinction: trustmark_bbox_Q.ckpt is an additional external detector, distinct from the TrustMark Q assets used by the starter-kit extractor and submission 1210. Frozen weights alone do not establish contest eligibility.
competition_eligibility.confirmation: Melvyn, team lead, stated on 2026-11-21: 'Ok, vas y, on a le droit donc faisons ca avec Adobe'. This records the user's confirmation; no independent organizer message was obtained by the assistant.
competition_eligibility.submission_policy: Proceed with the Adobe detector under the team lead's confirmation. Export and submit only if the predeclared held-out validation gate passes.

bbox_trial_declared_before_results.weight_rule: alpha times detector confidence; highest-confidence box; pixel-center rasterization; unchanged prediction when no usable box
bbox_trial_declared_before_results.selection: Select alpha independently inside each original inner tuning split; no outer labels for fitting, box adjustment, threshold or weight choice
bbox_trial_declared_before_results.promotion: Same strict gate: positive gains in all five folds, mean gain >= 0.002, positive conditional 99% bootstrap lower bound
bbox_trial_declared_before_results.limitations: Repeated architecture selection on a small development dataset is not a pristine test. The organizer's hidden split remains independent.
